description: Base token safety check before you buy or accept a token: simulates a real buy, wallet-to-wallet transfer and sell on the deepest Uniswap v2/v3 or Aerodrome WETH pool, and reports honeypot (sell reverts), buy/sell/transfer tax, liquidity depth, LP burn share, proxy/upgradeability, owner and privileged functions (mint, blacklist, pause, fees), owner supply share, with a 0-100 risk score and OK/CAUTION/DANGER verdict. Costs 0.02 USDC on Base, paid via x402.
name: base_token_check
